note: Sidecar listing institutes already in data/mba/colleges/ (slug = colleges/<slug>.json) or data/mba/programs/ (slug = programs/<slug>.json) whose OFFICIAL pages list the specialisation. 'basis' gives the strength of the evidence: 'dedicated programme' = a whole MBA/PGDM in that field; 'named specialisation' = a listed specialisation, major or track; 'area of specialisation (electives)' = the official page says students specialise through electives in a named area that covers the field. Elective areas the institute does not describe as a specialisation are excluded (see checkedNotOffered). Evidence is paraphrased. Sources are official institute pages only. Updated 2026-11-12 after new colleges/ records (MANAGE, EDII, IIPS DAVV, IPE Hyderabad) were added: their programmes now count.

International Business.institute: Indian Institute of Foreign Trade, New Delhi
International Business.evidence: The flagship two-year MBA is itself an International Business degree.

International Business.programme: Post Graduate Diploma in Management - International Business (PGDM-IB)
International Business.evidence: Separate CAT/GMAT-based PGDM-IB with a dual degree from Emlyon or ESCP; needs a 4-year bachelor's and 1 year of work experience.

A separate two-year PGDM in international business (intake 60, running since 2009) covering international finance, marketing, global supply chains and country/currency risk; listed alongside the general PGDM in the 2027-29 brochure.

IT/Systems Management.evidence: Information Technology Management is one of the PGDM specialisation areas, with its own elective basket (IT outsourcing, digital business, blockchain and similar courses).

source.title: IMT Ghaziabad PGDM Full Time programme page

IT/Systems Management.institute: Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies (JBIMS)
IT/Systems Management.evidence: Systems is one of the five MMS specialisations, alongside Finance, Marketing, Operations and HR.
Information Systems is listed among the PGDM-BM specialisation areas.

IT/Systems Management.institute: S. P. Jain Institute of Management & Research (SPJIMR)
IT/Systems Management.evidence: Information Management & Analytics is one of the four PGDM specialisations. It combines IT management and analytics.
Second-year students may specialise in up to two functional areas, one of which is Information Management; a specialisation needs at least five electives (15 credits) from that area.
The MBA curriculum lists Information Systems and Analytics among the second-year areas of specialisation.

IT/Systems Management.programme: Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGPM / MBA)
IT/Systems Management.evidence: In the second year students can specialise by taking electives from areas that include Information Systems & Analytics.

Entrepreneurship.evidence: Strategy, Innovation and Entrepreneurship is a PGDM specialisation area with its own electives, such as entrepreneurial finance, HR for start-ups and start-up incubation.

source.title: IMT Ghaziabad PGDM Full Time programme page

Entrepreneurship.programme: Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGPM / MBA)

checkedNotOffered: welingkar-mumbai: International Business is a core course in trimester IV for every major, not a specialisation. Majors are Marketing, Finance, HR and Operations (PGDM brochure 2026-28 and the PGDM page).

kjsim-mumbai: the five MBA majors are Business Analytics & Data Science, Finance, HR, Marketing and Operations/SCM. No IB, IT/systems, entrepreneurship or agribusiness major. Business Analytics & Data Science was not counted as IT/systems.

nmims-mumbai: the flagship MBA has no IB, IT or entrepreneurship specialisation on its official pages. International Business Management is only a second-year elective. Its MBA (Business Analytics), MBA (Digital Transformation) and the Pravin Dalal School of Entrepreneurship programmes are separate and were not counted.
great-lakes-chennai: the PGDM specialisations are marketing, finance, operations and business analytics. The entrepreneurship programme is the separate 1-year PGPM-FBE (see candidatesNotInData).

iim-ahmedabad (MBA-PGP): Entrepreneurship, Information Systems and Agri Management are elective areas only, with no named specialisation. Not counted for the PGP. Agribusiness is counted through MBA-FABM.
iim-kozhikode: Information Technology and Systems is an elective area, and International Business is a compulsory course. Neither is called a specialisation, so not counted.
iim-nagpur: Strategy and Entrepreneurship and Decision Science & Information Systems are elective areas. The curriculum page has no named tracks, so not counted.

iim-ranchi, iim-udaipur, iim-bodh-gaya (flagship MBA), iim-raipur: only elective areas or courses in these fields (IS & BA, Strategy & Entrepreneurship, International Business courses). IIM Raipur's major/minor areas do not include these four. Not counted.
iim-sambalpur: Information Management and Entrepreneurial Innovation specialisations exist only in the MBA for Working Professionals, not the flagship MBA. Not counted.
iim-bangalore: Entrepreneurship and Information Systems are faculty areas. The PGP has no named specialisation on the programme page. Not counted.
fms-delhi: its 2027 prospectus mentions IT and Entrepreneurship only as career or interest areas, not specialisations.
sibm-pune: specialisations are Marketing, HRM, Finance, Operations & SCM and Data Analytics. None of the four.

Not checked in depth or no programme page reachable: imi-delhi (the page lists only PGDM, PGDM-HRM and PGDM-B&FS), pumba-pune (department site unreachable), bimm-pune (domain unreachable), dms-iit-delhi, sjmsom-iit-bombay, tiss-mumbai (HR programme), and the remaining IIMs (Calcutta, Indore, Jammu, Kashipur, Mumbai, Rohtak, Shillong, Sirmaur, Visakhapatnam). Pages fetched for these showed no named specialisation in the four fields.
